adaptation: Paper X-12 scheduler-priority idea adapted to UE6 URLLC packets; separate from the legacy AR/MEC X-12.

target_kpis.ue_6_completed_packet_mean_latency_ms: minimize when completions exist; original deadline remains 10 ms
target_kpis.network_goodput_mbps: tie-break; UE2 predicted failure rate guarded against same-context RR

rcp.ue_scheduler_weights: Complete served-UE maps: UE6 weight 1, 1.5 or 2; all other weights 1. Empty cell map is {}.
rcp.mapping: Existing latency-aware base scores and unchanged NR packing; native RR and neutral-family arms included.

measurement: Global 100 ms counter-delta windows after all-cell executed ownership confirmation and 20 ms wash-in. Outcome windows include carryover; they are not arrival-cohort failure probabilities.
training: 24 actual global rows, six per arm; balanced online collection, cap 48, batched 32-tree depth-6 RF. No labels from forecasts.
evaluation: Frozen JSON inference; mature unique packet-ID 10 ms failure union is the authoritative offline SLA check. The RF peer guard is not a calibrated safety bound.
